en.summary: This commit fixes a ROP backend deadlock by splitting depth/stencil and color request masks and by retiring canceled zero-mask writes from pending-read accounting.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a deadlock fix.
The patch changes central ROP memory-request generation and retirement logic in DUT files.
The added degenerate-request handling prevents outstanding-read bookkeeping from getting stuck on requests that collapse to no memory work.
disqualifiers: The commit also touches trace and helper code outside the core ROP fix.
evidence: VX_rop_unit replaces the old single mem_req_mask flow with separate mem_req_ds_mask and mem_req_c_mask signals.
VX_rop_unit adds is_degenerate_req, suppresses mem_req_valid_r for zero-mask requests, and generates write_req_canceled.
The pending_reads counter now decrements on write_req_canceled as well as mem_write_notify.
VX_rop_mem now consumes the precomputed DS and color masks directly instead of recomputing one shared gate locally.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A late-fragment backend can launch a read-modify-write sequence whose depth/stencil side and color side are both conditionally canceled after per-fragment tests, write masks, or blend enables are applied. If that collapsed request is still counted as an outstanding operation but never generates a real memory transaction or a local cancel-retirement event, queue credits do not return and the backend can deadlock.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A ROP-style request reaches the memory stage, but all destination masks become zero after depth/stencil tests, color write-mask checks, or blend gating.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Let the zero-mask write consume outstanding-request bookkeeping without generating a matching local retirement event.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop degenerate-request cancellation or merge per-target masks too early
portability_notes: Apply this to designs that share one outstanding-request counter across depth/stencil and color writeback paths.
The bug is in control and accounting logic, not in depth compare or blending arithmetic.
Per-lane or per-target masks are the key portability hook: reproduce the case where every lane is canceled after the request has already reserved resources.
concrete_injection_steps: Keep the enqueue-side outstanding counter increment for read-modify-write style fragment operations.
Remove or bypass the logic that detects when all destination masks resolve to zero before memory issue.
Retire outstanding credits only on real memory write completion, not on locally canceled no-op writes.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ROP request mask generation and pending_reads retirement
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix splits depth/stencil and color masks, drops degenerate requests before they reach the memory scheduler, and decrements pending_reads when a write request is canceled locally.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the older shared-mask path, remove is_degenerate_req and write_req_canceled handling, and make pending_reads decrement only on mem_write_notify.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Fragments that collapse to no-op writes can occupy pending-read capacity forever, eventually stalling the ROP backend or blocking fragment completion.
evidence_for_injection: The real fix introduces explicit zero-mask detection with is_degenerate_req.
The fix also adds write_req_canceled specifically to drain pending_reads for canceled writes.
The source patch separates DS and color masks so each side can cancel independently before memory submission.
notes: A narrower reinjection is to keep the mask split but remove the write_req_canceled path from pending_reads decrement logic.

zh.summary: 该提交通过拆分 depth/stencil 与 color 请求掩码，并在零掩码写请求被本地取消时正确回收 pending-read 计数，修复了 ROP 后端死锁。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明是在修复死锁。
补丁修改了 DUT 文件中的核心 ROP 内存请求生成与退休逻辑。
新增的退化请求处理避免了“已经占用未决读计数、但最终没有任何内存操作”的请求把记账卡死。
disqualifiers: 该提交还改动了与核心 ROP 修复无关的 trace 和辅助代码。
evidence: VX_rop_unit 把旧的单一 mem_req_mask 流程改成了独立的 mem_req_ds_mask 与 mem_req_c_mask。
VX_rop_unit 新增 is_degenerate_req，零掩码请求不再驱动 mem_req_valid_r，并生成 write_req_canceled。
pending_reads 计数现在既会在 mem_write_notify 时递减，也会在 write_req_canceled 时递减。
VX_rop_mem 现在直接消费预先计算好的 DS 和 color 掩码，而不是在本地重新合成一个共享 gate。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在延迟片段后端中，一次读-改-写操作的 depth/stencil 侧和 color 侧都可能在深度/模板测试、写掩码或 blend 使能之后被条件性取消。如果这种已经坍缩成 no-op 的请求仍然被记为未完成操作，但既不会真正发出内存事务，也不会触发本地的“取消退休”，那么队列 credit 就不会归还，后端最终可能死锁。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: ROP 类请求到达内存阶段后，depth/stencil 测试、color 写掩码检查或 blend gate 使所有目标掩码都变成零。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让这个零掩码写请求继续占用未决请求记账，但不给它生成对应的本地退休事件。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop degenerate-request cancellation or merge per-target masks too early
portability_notes: 把该故障映射到那些由同一个未决请求计数器同时管理 depth/stencil 和 color 写回路径的设计中。
问题出在控制和记账逻辑，而不在深度比较或混色运算本身。
可移植的关键是“按 lane 或按目标的掩码”：复现所有 lane 在请求已占用资源后又全部被取消的情况。
concrete_injection_steps: 保留对 read-modify-write 类片段操作的入队侧未决计数递增。
移除或绕过“在发出内存请求前检测所有目标掩码是否都变成零”的逻辑。
把未决 credit 的回收限定为只在真实内存写完成时发生，而不是在本地取消的 no-op 写上发生。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ROP request mask generation and pending_reads retirement
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 depth/stencil 与 color 掩码拆开，在请求进入内存调度器前丢弃退化请求，并在写请求被本地取消时递减 pending_reads。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复旧的共享掩码路径，去掉 is_degenerate_req 与 write_req_canceled 处理，并让 pending_reads 只在 mem_write_notify 时递减。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 已经坍缩为 no-op 写的片段请求会永久占住 pending-read 容量，最终让 ROP 后端停住或阻塞片段完成。
evidence_for_injection: 真实修复显式引入了 is_degenerate_req 来检测零掩码请求。
修复还专门把 write_req_canceled 加入 pending_reads 回收路径，用于处理被取消的写。
源补丁把 DS 与 color 掩码拆开，使两边都能在送往内存前独立取消。
notes: 如果希望做更窄的注入，可保留掩码拆分，只移除 pending_reads 递减逻辑中的 write_req_canceled 路径。
